title: Candlewicking on a closed line, entry L1 (29.8, 30), exit L2 (25.5, 30), Start/End Feed
description: A closed straight line (10,10)-(50,10)-(50,30)-(10,30) mm sewn as Candlewicking at PE-DESIGN's defaults, with the line entry point L1 at (29.8, 30) and the exit point L2 at (25.5, 30), Start/End Type Feed. PE-DESIGN 11.50 keeps every element where it is without the moved points and only changes where the sewing starts and ends: the pattern starts with the running stitch into the knot at the exit point L2 and sews that knot last. Compared: the stitch count, where the needle starts and ends, and the longest stitch.

references.make: File > New (Design Page 100 x 100 mm, grid 1 mm, Snap to Grid). Shapes > Closed Straight Line: click (10, 10), (50, 10), (50, 30) and double-click (10, 30) mm. Region Not Sewn; line colour 800 RED; line sew type Candlewicking at the attributes PE-DESIGN shows for the type (Medium, size 5.0, spacing 1.0). With Select > Select Entry/Exit Points drag the line entry point L1 along the outline to the middle of the bottom edge, then the exit point L2; PE-DESIGN shows them at about (25.5, 30) and (29.8, 30) mm (the log names the first L1; the files show the pattern starting at it, which is where the exit point puts it, see the -mid references). In Sewing Attributes > Line sew set Start/End Type Feed. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system, where PE-DESIGN shows L1 and L2, and the status-bar size and stitch count in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).
